name: Westfield Culver City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier luxury shopping destination in Los Angeles featuring world-class retail, dining, and entertainment experiences. The center showcases iconic brands and hosts exclusive events like the Taylor Swift Experience, offering visitors an unforgettable blend of high-end shopping and cultural attractions. With its stunning modern architecture and curated mix of global retailers, Westfield Century City stands as one of Southern California's most prestigious shopping centers.
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, style-conscious demographic with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000, drawing heavily from nearby Beverly Hills, West Los Angeles, and Santa Monica. The primary visitor base consists of professionals aged 25-54, luxury shoppers, entertainment industry executives, and international tourists seeking premium retail experiences. Shoppers demonstrate strong preferences for luxury brands, contemporary fashion, and upscale dining, with high per-visit spending and frequent return visits driven by the center's proximity to wealthy residential neighborhoods and entertainment industry hubs.
